verdict.rationale: Qodo's code governance docs say leaders can "see a complete history of findings, decisions, and codebase health" and "gain insight" across repositories. That is a first-party org-level view of findings and how they were handled. However, nothing documents dashboards, acceptance-rate metrics or review-coverage reporting specifically. Missing for 10: explicit dashboard documentation, acceptance-rate metrics, review-coverage metrics, org-wide aggregation detail, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering lead, I see dashboards of findings, acceptance rates, and review coverage across my org
